decisions.reason: This solid state relay module is a core-adjacent, low-carry-cost building block in the automation platform, so we keep it as a durable option unless clearer evidence of weak demand emerges.

The server room monitoring kit is more niche and by now its market potential should be clearer, but because it largely repackages existing modules at limited cost we keep it one more year while watching adoption closely.
The RGB LED control module is still too new and inexpensive relative to the platform to abandon early, so we keep the option open while demand across developer and automation uses becomes clearer.
The remote access service for wallboxes sits in the firm's chosen charging and energy-management growth path, so despite service overhead we keep it and assign only a modest withdrawal risk.
